Overview

Sucre is a city in CH with a population of 298,000. Bolivia’s constitutional capital and UNESCO World Heritage city, famous for its well-preserved colonial white architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
